steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, places: 1, aqua_btn: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 10; FB.hud.update();

steps.name: подсказка: подарок
steps.js: FB.tasks.open('daily'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); const c = document.querySelector('.coach'); return c && !c.classList.contains('hidden') ? c.innerText.slice(0, 60) : 'нет';
